description: A shell script containing test cases and setup for Git large file handling features, including configuration, adding large files, packing, diffing, and verification tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, takes a description and a shell command block.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the command output is empty.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path is missing.

methods.name: test-tool
methods.description: Runs a test utility for generating random data.

methods.name: test_file_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a specified file.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.
